root_cause_summary: A configuration change enabled a recalculation job for one account. The job issued several hundred single-row UPDATEs inside one transaction, holding exclusive locks for 20-30 seconds at a time and producing a cascading blocking chain and deadlocks on the primary.
key_findings: Blocking chain head is the recalculation job's batch-statement transaction, matching its stack trace
The configuration change landed ~16 minutes before blocking began
Exclusive locks measured at 20-30 seconds, well past the lock timeout of dependent readers
Two job traces show deadlock victims rolled back and retried
